versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census ward-level worker counts (Table PCA-TV) as spatial weights across all 155 Chennai Corporation wards, replacing the old subdistrict-level average. The real citywide jobs total (SHRUG 2013 Economic Census, 1,617,133) is unchanged — only its spatial distribution is now ward-by-ward instead of an even subdistrict spread. All 155 wards matched a Census weight with zero gaps, confirmed by both a direct data join and a full production run with exact conservation.

Fixed job totals, which were being calculated from Chennai Corporation's old, pre-2011 ward boundary, covering under half the map's actual population. The OMR/Sholinganallur IT corridor plus Ambattur, Tambaram, and Alandur were getting zero jobs. Now using real 2011 Census worker counts across the full map area. Job total: 1,817,297 -> 4,093,094.

Removed ~86,600 residents incorrectly modeled on top of Chennai International Airport and other aviation infrastructure (up from ~72,900 in the polygon-only pass, now also covering aeroway features mapped as OSM lines), and widened the spatial binning resolution for faster in-game loading.
